description: Apply the governance-approved remediation for a finding (simulated: mutates the application data model only, not real infrastructure). SAFETY: the patch is applied only when the finding's decision_state is 'allow'; findings under manual_review or deny are refused. On success the finding status becomes 'remediated' and a REMEDIATION_EXECUTED audit event is appended. Idempotent: a finding already 'remediated' returns success without re-applying.

finding_id.description: UUID of the finding to remediate. Must be a finding whose governance decision_state is 'allow'.

action_id.description: Optional idempotency hint for the remediation action. If omitted, it is taken from the finding's governance proposal (proposal_jsonb.action_id).
